disclaimer.title: Medical disclaimer:
disclaimer.body: This application provides general suggestions and does not replace medical advice. For any health concern, please consult a specialist. Recommendations are based on general information and may not be suitable for every user.

selectors.allergiesHint: Select every allergy that affects you. Recommendations will automatically exclude foods containing these allergens.
selectors.conditionsHint: Select the conditions that affect you. Recommendations will take them into account.

lactoza.label: Lactose / Dairy
lactoza.description: Allergies to dairy products (milk, cheese, yogurt, etc.)

gluten.label: Gluten
gluten.description: Allergies to gluten-containing products (wheat, bread, pasta, etc.)

nuci.label: Tree nuts
nuci.description: Allergies to walnuts, hazelnuts, almonds, pistachios, etc.

oua.label: Eggs
oua.description: Allergies to eggs and egg-containing products

soia.label: Soy
soia.description: Allergies to soy and derived products (tofu, tempeh, etc.)

peste.label: Fish
peste.description: Allergies to fish and fish products

crustacee.label: Shellfish
crustacee.description: Allergies to shrimp, crab, lobster, etc.

arahide.label: Peanuts
arahide.description: Allergies to peanuts and peanut-containing products

sesam.label: Sesame
sesam.description: Allergies to sesame seeds and sesame-containing products

mustar.label: Mustard
mustar.description: Allergies to mustard and mustard-containing products

moluste.label: Molluscs
moluste.description: Allergies to mussels, clams, oysters, squid

diabet.label: Diabetes
diabet.description: Requires attention to carbohydrates and glycemic index

tiroida.label: Thyroid disorders
tiroida.description: Iodine, selenium; avoid excess soy in some cases

insuficienta_renala.label: Kidney failure
insuficienta_renala.description: Limit potassium, phosphorus, protein (depending on stage)

iritații_intestinale.label: Irritable bowel syndrome
iritații_intestinale.description: Adapted fibre intake, avoid personal triggers

deficienta_b12.label: Vitamin B12 deficiency
deficienta_b12.description: Meat, fish, eggs; supplements if needed

colesterol_ridicat.label: High cholesterol
colesterol_ridicat.description: Unsaturated fats, fibre, avoid trans fats

gout.label: Gout
gout.description: Limit purines (red meat, seafood), stay hydrated

sarcina.label: Pregnancy
sarcina.description: We exclude raw fish, high-mercury fish, liver and soft mould-ripened cheese

anticoagulante.label: Anticoagulants (warfarin, acenocoumarol)
anticoagulante.description: Steady vitamin K: no portions very high in vitamin K

hemocromatoza.label: Haemochromatosis
hemocromatoza.description: We don't recommend foods to raise iron

imunitate_scazuta.label: Weakened immunity
imunitate_scazuta.description: We exclude raw fish and shellfish and soft mould-ripened cheese

why.iron: Iron helps form red blood cells and carry oxygen around your body.
why.calcium: Calcium is needed to keep your bones and teeth healthy.
why.vitamin_d: Vitamin D helps keep your bones healthy and supports normal immune function.
why.vitamin_b12: Vitamin B12 helps form red blood cells and supports a normal nervous system.
why.magnesium: Magnesium helps reduce tiredness and supports normal muscle function.
why.folate: Folate helps normal blood formation and supports tissue growth during pregnancy.
why.vitamin_a: Vitamin A helps maintain normal vision.
why.vitamin_c: Vitamin C supports immune function and increases iron absorption.
why.iodine: Iodine helps your thyroid make hormones normally.
why.vitamin_k: Vitamin K helps your blood clot normally.
why.potassium: Potassium supports normal muscle function and normal blood pressure.

serve.nuts: A handful as a snack or sprinkled over yogurt.
serve.seeds: Sprinkled over salad, yogurt or porridge.
serve.leafy_greens: In a salad or as a side, with a drizzle of oil.
serve.vegetables: As a side with your main meal or in a salad.
serve.fruits: As a snack between meals or at breakfast.
serve.dried_fruits: A small handful is enough: they are high in natural sugar.
serve.fish: Baked or grilled, with vegetables on the side.
serve.shellfish: Well cooked, steamed or in a tomato sauce.
serve.meat: Roasted or grilled, with a side of vegetables.
serve.poultry: Roasted or grilled, with a side of vegetables.
serve.offal: Well cooked, with onions and vegetables.
serve.eggs: At breakfast or in a salad.
serve.dairy: At breakfast or as a snack.
serve.cheese: A small portion on a slice of wholegrain bread or in a salad.
serve.plant_milks: In porridge, coffee or a smoothie. Shake the carton first: the added calcium settles at the bottom.
serve.whole_grains: As the base of a meal, with vegetables and a protein source.
serve.refined_grains: With vegetables and a protein source.

tip.iron: Add a source of vitamin C to the same meal (peppers, lemon, kiwi): it helps you absorb iron from plants. Tea and coffee with the meal make it harder.
tip.calcium_iron: Calcium at the same meal lowers iron absorption: keep calcium-rich foods for a different meal from your iron foods.
tip.vitamin_d: Vitamin D is absorbed better at a meal that also contains a little fat.
tip.vitamin_a: Vitamin A is absorbed better with a little fat, for example a drizzle of oil.
tip.vitamin_b12_vegan: On a vegan diet, B12 only comes from fortified foods or supplements. Talk to your doctor about a supplement.
tip.vitamin_k_anticoagulant: If you take warfarin or acenocoumarol, eat about the same amount of leafy greens every day.
tip.zinc: Soak legumes for a few hours before cooking: zinc is absorbed better.
tip.folate: For folate, cook briefly by steaming or eat it raw: long boiling destroys part of it.
tip.vitamin_c: Vitamin C is lost with heat: raw or briefly cooked is best.
tip.iodine: When you cook, use iodised salt, but only a little: even a small amount provides iodine.

warning.pregnancy_cooked: If you are pregnant, eat it only when well cooked.
warning.liver_weekly: Liver is very high in vitamin A: no more than one portion a week.
warning.raw_fresh: Choose it only very fresh, from a source you trust.
